machine_numbering_policy.observed_style: All122 TM and10 HM display standard code labels, e.g.TM00..TM121 andHM01..HM10; messages7/8 absent for these names is a family convention, not a single HM08 prose omission.
machine_numbering_policy.recommended: Keep machine labels and IDs as TMxx/HMxx uniformly, including HM08. Translate explanatory HM prose to秘传学习器; active machine toast adds localized move name闪光 forHM08.
machine_numbering_policy.do_not_apply: Do not only rename HM08 to秘传学习器08 while other labels stay HMxx. Any alternative prefix must be a separately unified display-family policy, never an ID rewrite.

item_review_scope_note: CJK/mixed-language statistics are a screening catalogue, not a claim that all692 item descriptions were semantically proofread. The21 mixed candidates plus related rank/description fields were explicitly reviewed here, producing26 localized-table suggestions; CTRL,Dem,MMM and machine codes are not blindly deleted. Per-map acquisition was not executed.
limitations: Static source/data review only; no in-game battle/reward playtest.
400 preset fields/393 strings are catalogued, but only expert28 strings are linguistically translated in this report; full393 is a separately assigned review.
